opportunity.title: DHS IT Modernization Support: Legacy System Analysis and ERP Migration Planning
opportunity.agency: Department of Homeland Security — Office of the Chief Financial Officer
opportunity.placeOfPerformance: Washington, DC (hybrid, 3 days on-site per week required)
opportunity.description: DHS Office of the Chief Financial Officer seeks IT modernization consulting support to (1) document and analyze legacy financial management systems currently running on a 2008-era Oracle platform, (2) develop a migration roadmap to a modern SAP S/4HANA ERP system per OMB A-123 requirements, and (3) produce a data mapping document for migrating Chart of Accounts, vendor master data, and open purchase orders. Contractor must demonstrate experience with federal financial management systems and familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP platforms. Additionally, the contractor shall develop a web-based project dashboard (React or Vue.js) to track migration milestones and surface KPIs to DHS leadership. Approximately 60% of effort is ERP analysis and roadmapping; 40% is web dashboard development. Period of performance: 9 months. Three days per week on-site in Washington DC is mandatory.
